name: Suspicious Fireside Merriment
desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The dense fat, bitter and salty, hits the palate like a runaway carriage, leaving a lingering, oily trail down the throat... an intense assault few could endure.

value.text: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
